title: Simple ALU
statement: Design an 8-bit ALU that performs add, subtract, AND, OR, and NOT operations selected by a 3-bit opcode. The module must produce a valid result for every opcode and handle two’s complement subtraction correctly. The NOT operation should apply only to operand a while ignoring operand b.
module_signature: module simple_alu_8bit(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input [2:0] op, output reg [7:0] result, output reg zero);
behavior: Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use behavioral arrays or function calls for operation selection.
hint: Implement each operation explicitly and choose with a case statement.
